events.label: IDF operations in Qusra and Jalud

slots.name: confiscated vehicles
slots.sentence: In addition, the security forces confiscated vehicles belonging to the Israeli rioters that were suspected of having been used to reach the area,” the statement said.

slots.name: attacks on journalists
slots.sentence: The United Nations and media workers have also reported an uptick in attacks on foreign, Palestinian and Israeli journalists in the West Bank.

slots.name: settler violence status
slots.sentence: There has been a spate of Israeli settler violence in the West Bank, and the village of Qusra has been besieged by Israeli settlers for weeks.

slots.name: number of rioters identified
slots.sentence: “Upon their arrival, the security forces identified dozens of rioters who had barricaded themselves inside a Palestinian home while Palestinian residents were inside,” the statement said.
